caption: Yesterday's unthinkable becomes today's unremarkable, quietly. Catch it mid-transition. Stuck? Pick a card: https://www.uncommonsense.org.uk/strategies

caption: Failure gets the headlines. What's thriving, and why isn't anyone studying it? The rest of the deck: https://www.uncommonsense.org.uk/strategies

caption: The view from the top is a summary. The view from the bottom is the detail. The full deck: https://www.uncommonsense.org.uk/strategies

alt_text: Uncommon Strategies card: 'Find the feedback loop no one is tracking'. Cream serif type on a forest green background.

caption: Power's fears are a map of its weaknesses. Publicly available, rarely read. The rest of the deck: https://www.uncommonsense.org.uk/strategies
